Strictly parse and normalize a portable GraphBlueprint evidence value.

Unknown versions and fields fail closed. Diagnostics, when present, must exactly describe the
normalized topology; hash bytes are verified separately with {@link verifyBlueprintHash}.

## Import

```ts
import { parseGraphBlueprint } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
```

## Signature

```ts
function parseGraphBlueprint(value: unknown): GraphBlueprintEvidence
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `unknown` | Untrusted value read from a wire artifact or another process. |

## Returns

A deeply frozen normalized GraphBlueprint.
